about_short_description.short_description: Phoenix is a digital health platform providing telemedicine services for men's health, treating ED, hair loss, PE, and weight loss.

product.name: Erectile Dysfunction Treatment
product.description: A telemedicine service providing prescription medications to treat erectile dysfunction through online consultation with licensed Canadian physicians.

product.name: Weight Loss Program
product.description: An online medical weight loss program pairing patients with doctors and GLP-1 medications to support weight loss through telemedicine.

product.name: Hair Loss Treatment
product.description: A telehealth service offering prescription medications for male pattern hair loss, including finasteride and minoxidil, through online doctor consultations and home delivery.

product.name: Premature Ejaculation Treatment
product.description: An upcoming telemedicine service providing prescription medications to manage premature ejaculation through online consultation and home delivery.

product.name: Generic semaglutide direct-to-patient service
product.description: Direct-to-patient telehealth service providing access to Health Canada–approved generic semaglutide by prescription across Canada.
